subject: environmental-science
title: Food Chains & Webs: Foundations
welcome_lead: Energy flows from the Sun through plants and animals — meet the chain.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: producers, consumers, food chain.
final_note: Every chain begins with a plant catching sunlight.

concepts.def: Plant that makes its own food from sunlight.
Animal that eats other living things.
Animal that eats plants and meat.

walkthroughs.body_html: Producers are plants and algae. They make sugar from sunlight, CO2 and water — photosynthesis. All food chains start with them.
Herbivores eat producers. Carnivores eat herbivores. Omnivores eat both. Each step gets less energy than the one before.
Arrows in a food chain show the flow of energy — from the eaten to the eater. Grass → rabbit → fox. Grass feeds rabbit; rabbit feeds fox.
